verification.blenderInterchange: generated/world-v5/interchange-verification.json: world-v5-r1 BLEND/FBX/GLB passed; 325264 triangles, 29 meshes, 14 unchanged anchors. Local boulder intersection cleanup preserves all remaining vertex positions and colors; ground texture hashes unchanged.
verification.characterRoundTrip: generated/character-v5/frozen-export-verification.json: FBX/GLB passed, 53956 triangles, 62 renderers including 28 skinned meshes, 4 armatures / 12 bones. Native Blender rig; 144 evaluated sole poses checked separately in gait-verification.json.
verification.purePuzzleRules: independently checked by gameplay implementation agent
verification.windowsRuntime: verification/run-016-v6/runtime-results.json: all functional checks passed; real movement 2.286m, cabin/boulder collision, walkway and observatory grounding, and central instrument collision verified. Two actual Unity-skinned soles: 220 idle-pose ground samples, minimum clearance 0.001412m. 1440x900 Iris Xe short samples: menu 57.3, overview 52.7, walking 41.6, portrait 60 FPS; final-view 43.7. Prior pre-fix run-015-v6 walking was 57.9; variation is observed, cause not established. Idle sole samples do not verify every moving pose.
verification.webRuntime: verification/web-006-v6/runtime-results.json: real-keyboard completion, reload persistence, walking, ending return and default audio policy passed. Foreground 1440x900 Iris Xe interval-FPS medians: menu 38.53, ending 43.88, walking 29.00. Previous pre-fix web-005-v6 walking was 34.63; variation is observed, cause not established. No captured browser exceptions; hidden-shader, INVALID_ENUM and sound-loading engine diagnostics remain. Rolling averages include earlier views and are not current-view measurements. Actual served payload identity is recorded in web-006-v6/build-evidence.json.
verification.finalVisualComparison: verification/visual-review.html uses run-016-v6 native captures, original reference images, and v5/run-013-v5 comparison. Shallow crowned stepping stones, foreground boulders and subtle leaf gradients add depth; intersecting plants and hard moss patches were corrected. Character skin, fabric folds and rock detail remain simpler than the reference. Pre-fix gait found observatory penetration; native collider checks now pass. Fixed browser gait screenshots 07/08/09 show supported shoes on the platform during ascent and after stopping; different route timings prevent exact-pose comparison. Static samples and one video route do not verify every moving pose. The overall aesthetic objective is not yet achieved.
verification.shaderChecks: verification/v6-integration-checks.json; tinted FoliagePaint compiled, all 29 imported island meshes retain vertex colors, 27 renderers are in static batches. GPU profile in verification/web-v6-gpu-profile/ belongs to the pre-collider-fix build_1d3e76e5b3ab: about 1030 draws/frame versus v5 about 1116, no clear walking FPS gain. Different speed, endpoint, world and rig prevent attributing the entire change to batching; this GPU profile was not repeated after the collider-only fix.
verification.browserGait: verification/web-v6-gait-fixed/capture-manifest.json and build-evidence.json identify actual-keyboard recording of build_d4eac3ac8c31. Separate video capture is visual evidence, not an FPS benchmark. Main route shows platform ascent and planted feet. An additional observatory-contact/capture-manifest.json records a frontal W approach, another 1.6 seconds of W, unchanged stopped position, and a side view outside the instrument; it supports blocking on this tested approach without game-state injection. It does not verify every possible route or moving pose.
